assay_clarification: Y1062 is a signaling/docking phosphosite. Its direct detection measures site phosphorylation; alone it is not proof of catalytic activation or RET dependence. Y905 and Y1062 remain separately named outcomes, not interchangeable pathway proof. The prospective useful question is a direct RET phosphorylation contrast beyond total RET/RNA; any catalytic-activation claim additionally requires supporting assays, specificity and source interpretation.
